# Vedansh repository instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [the shared build checklist](../docs/engineering/vedansh-build-checklist.md) before implementation or implementation review. Follow the existing RULEBOOK.md, design.md and wiki/PRD for the affected feature.

Apply U1–U12 and relevant C1–C10. Preserve approved designs, all four reading languages and Standard/Large layouts, existing navigation/state, complete content/artwork integration and startup budgets. Check sibling surfaces for recurring defects.

Commit and push coherent checkpoints early; open a draft PR when requested and verify remote preservation before worktree cleanup. Reconcile required untracked assets and record handover. Never delete the only copy of unfinished work.

Use the PR evidence template and report PASS / FAIL / PENDING / N/A with actual results. A mockup, parsed YAML or bundle export is not native visual QA. Keep required pending checks draft. Do not merge, release or publish an OTA merely because an implementation is complete.
